detail.title: Updating Neurodiversity Foundations: Evidence Review
detail.summary: I am updating the existing provisional notebook for the neurodiversity paradigm project to align with the current, verified evidentiary record. The previous notebook relied on sources that were not in the current project-specific allowlist. The current evidence (bibliographic metadata for a reference book and a monograph on linguistics) is insufficient to substantively define the neurodiversity paradigm versus clinical pathology models, establishing a clear evidence gap. I am initiating a new targeted search to locate seminal texts that directly address this conceptual comparison.
